prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. ONE woman, facing the camera in a frontal view, framed from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Swedish woman, mid 20s, with a forest-elf archer anime heroine look brought to life, with softly pointed elf ears, with long pale honey-blonde waves with a bright curved highlight band across the crown, two thin braids pinned back at the sides and tiny golden leaves woven into the strands. Her complexion is fair porcelain with a light dusting of freckles, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in emerald-green contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long curled lashes, a soft moss-green and gold shimmer on the lids and tiny gold leaf-shaped gems at the outer corners, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about two-thirds of the width of her face in extremely exaggerated anime proportion, tall and perfectly round, set low on the face beneath a high smooth forehead and noticeably wider apart than normal, with a bold dark upper lash line, the iris filling the entire eye opening around a small round pupil, and several tiny extra sparkle highlights, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are soft and glossy, in a peach gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a gentle smile. A deep warm-pink blush spreads in large soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a faint tiny dot of shade, the bridge and nostrils vanishing, a tiny simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a tiny sharply pointed chin, and a small, narrow, inverted-triangle anime face shape with a slim jaw, the whole face small and delicate beside the huge eyes. A calm, bright, wide-eyed gaze with a hint of curiosity. Her skin, across her face, neck and shoulders, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders and collarbones, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead and collarbones, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless anime transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Jewelry: on each ear, three separate heavy ear weights of real dull grey lead hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a barrel-shaped weight, a square-sided cowbell, a hammer head; on the right ear a round bell, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim, a miniature anvil. Every weight is a dense, solid, soft, heavy, matte lump of dull grey lead about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears a real chunky sterling silver cable-chain necklace resting on her collarbones. Pose: head tilted slightly, one hand lightly touching the tip of one pointed ear.

Background: a softly blurred sunlit forest glade with golden light beams and green bokeh.

Lighting: bright, soft, even light across the face with only gentle shading, and a thin rim light along the hair and shoulders. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/4, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
